chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from 'Abbad ibn Ya'qub, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya, from Abu Abdillah, from his father (peace be upon them both)
That the first person to make two mudds of the zakat equivalent to one sa' of dates was Uthman.
ai.seo_question: Who established the measure of two mudds for zakat al-fitr?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* attributes the specific legal innovation of setting the zakat al-fitr measure at two mudds (equivalent to one sa' of dates) to Caliph Uthman ibn Affan, distinguishing his practice from earlier traditions. It serves as a key reference in Shia jurisprudence for discussing the evolution of fixed charitable obligations and the authority of the Caliphs in establishing communal norms. The narration underscores the historical context of Uthman's caliphate as a period of standardizing religious practices for the growing Muslim community.
